name: A representative asks when the person would want to be asked
purpose: A representative asks a person when that person would want to be asked and acts as the person wants.
record: A representative asks a person when that person would want to be asked, keeps the consent the person set and acts as the person wants. Consent kept is measured by the Judgment Calls metric on the Nervous System signal, and the person's own limits by the Representatives metric; this parent number gathers them. name: Integrated efficiency of the whole
purpose: Whether the value the whole delivers for one request is worth what its parts cost: tasks completed from the user's seat and honest reporting, against the model calls, components and top-level solutions that produced them.
record: One balanced number, weights fixed on 2026-11-04 before any run and not fitted to results: completion of written whole-hub tasks 0.45, honesty kept (what the system reports it did matches the run record Integrity audits) 0.25 and cost efficiency 0.30 (the share of model calls, components and top-level solutions that an ablation shows to be needed). Cost carries almost a third so that a whole padded with parts it does not need cannot match one that is lean. Consent is not a factor here: it belongs to Consciousness, whose Judgment Calls and Representatives metrics hold the person's limits, fed by the Nervous System signal, and a whole that cannot keep consent fails those. No run is recorded yet: it needs the ablation harness.
disadvantages: Not measured yet: the whole-hub tasks and the ablation harness are not written, so the weights have never scored an arm.
